methodology: Five eligible external diplomatic event candidates. One excluded internal EU regulation case retained separately for audit history. Signed and follow-up events are not equivalent to attributed influence.

cases.title: 2023 Camp David trilateral cooperation commitments
cases.caveat: Shared commitments do not by themselves prove US-caused policy change.
cases.verifiedObservation: Trilateral leaders issued joint principles in August 2023; April 2024 defense statement reports real-time DPRK missile-warning data sharing and a multi-year exercise plan.
missingEvidence: Attribution versus Japanese and Korean initiative

activity.note: Dated event and primary/official source identified; source content requires continued independent verification.

commitment.note: No signed counterpart commitment established from this record.

implementation.note: No harmonized before/after counterpart behavior measurement established.

attribution.note: No defensible counterfactual or causal attribution established.

durability.note: No common follow-up outcome measure established.

researchPlan.outcomeQuestion: Did trilateral missile-warning information sharing operate on an ongoing basis after the Camp David commitments?
researchPlan.baselineRequirement: Document pre-August-2023 information-sharing arrangements and operational limits.
researchPlan.followupRequirement: Find dated US/Japan/ROK defense ministry reports of operational exchanges, exercises, and continuity.
researchPlan.attributionAlternatives: Pre-existing US bilateral alliances and independent Japan-ROK reconciliation.
researchPlan.costRequirement: Identify direct defense coordination costs and concessions in comparable units.

cases.title: EU–Moldova Security and Defence Partnership
cases.caveat: Bilateral signature and follow-up are documented; neither proves EU-caused change or net diplomatic influence.
cases.verifiedObservation: EU and Moldova signed a security and defence partnership on 21 May 2024. A November 2024 bilateral dialogue followed, and a November 2025 joint statement describes continuing security cooperation. Earlier EU missions and Moldova's own strategic decisions predate the partnership.

evidenceAuditMethodology: Source-identified event records are not independently verified causal influence. Gate statuses indicate research coverage, not outcomes or influence. Empty gate means unassessed, not zero. Each sphere is reviewed against the same six gates.
researchPlanMethodology: Pre-registered research questions and source categories. Planned research is not a completed evidence audit. Never promote planned outcomes into measurements.
